title: Paul's First Missionary Journey
note: Paul's first journey with Barnabas, c. AD 46–48 (Acts 13–14). The narrative in Acts is detailed and the route well attested, though the exact sites of some inland cities are identified by tradition and archaeology rather than certainty.

points.note: The sending church, on the Orontes (Acts 13:1–3).
Across to Cyprus, Barnabas's homeland; the proconsul Sergius Paulus believed.
Landing in Pamphylia, on the mainland of Asia Minor.
Paul's great synagogue sermon; turning to the Gentiles (Acts 13:14–48).
Bold preaching, then a plot forced them on (Acts 14:1–6).
Mistaken for gods, then Paul was stoned and left for dead (Acts 14:8–20).
The furthest point; many disciples made before they turned back.
Home again, to report all that God had done (Acts 14:26–27).
